title: Domain Output Strategy: How We Finally Produce Market Picks and External Research
executive_summary: The repository has COMPLETE infrastructure for market research but ZERO execution. All four analysis methods (fundamental, technical, sentiment, quantitative) have detailed guides. SOP-018 defines the full workflow. 41 data sources are cataloged with 16 data-collection scripts. The only missing piece is DOING THE WORK. The primary blocker is not tooling -- it is the recursive pattern of building more infrastructure instead of using what exists. This strategy provides a concrete, single-session execution plan.

readiness_assessment.overall_verdict: READY TO EXECUTE. No additional tooling required for first picks.

fundamental.what_exists: Complete guide with valuation ratios (P/E, P/B, P/S, EV/EBITDA, PEG), growth metrics, balance sheet health checks, profitability metrics (ROE, ROIC), qualitative moat analysis, DCF template, and pick checklist.
fundamental.data_needed: Company financials, earnings data, balance sheet data
fundamental.execution_method: Claude can perform fundamental analysis using WebSearch/WebFetch to gather current financial data, then apply the checklist from fundamental.md. No scripts needed -- this is analytical work.

technical.what_exists: Complete guide with moving averages, MACD, RSI, stochastic oscillator, volume analysis, support/resistance, chart patterns, and pick checklist.
technical.data_needed: Historical price data, volume data, technical indicator calculations
technical.limitations: Cannot render charts visually. Must rely on numerical indicator values from APIs. Alpha Vantage has built-in technical indicator endpoints (SMA, EMA, RSI, MACD, etc.) which compensates.
technical.execution_method: Fetch technical indicators from Alpha Vantage API endpoints. Apply checklist criteria numerically.

sentiment.what_exists: Complete guide with news sentiment, social media signals, insider activity, institutional positioning, fear/greed metrics, and contrarian signals.
sentiment.data_needed: News articles, social media mentions, insider transactions, short interest
sentiment.execution_method: Aggregate news sentiment from multiple sources. Check Finnhub for insider transactions. Use WebSearch for current market sentiment indicators (VIX, AAII survey). Apply contrarian framework.

quantitative.what_exists: Complete guide with factor models, pairs trading, mean reversion, momentum, risk management, and pick checklist.
quantitative.data_needed: Historical price data for large universe, factor scores, statistical calculations
quantitative.limitations: Full quantitative screening requires programmatic processing of large datasets. Factor scoring across a stock universe requires systematic data collection. Pairs trading requires correlation/cointegration testing.
quantitative.execution_method: Can do SIMPLIFIED quant analysis: screen for momentum (12-month returns via Alpha Vantage), value factors (P/E, P/B via Finnhub fundamentals), and mean reversion signals. Full multi-factor models require more infrastructure.
quantitative.confidence_for_first_pick: LOW for full quant, MEDIUM for simplified factor screening

ai_quant_techniques.what_exists: Empty comparison template -- tables say 'populated by merge_research.py'. Never populated.
ai_quant_techniques.assessment: This is a placeholder, not a usable method. Skip entirely for first picks.

available_scripts_for_data_collection.not_available_for_market_data: CRITICAL GAP: No existing scripts specifically fetch stock prices, financial statements, or technical indicators from Alpha Vantage or Finnhub. The data-gathering scripts are oriented toward academic/news/web research, not financial market data.

execution_plan.strategy: Use Claude's built-in WebSearch and WebFetch capabilities as the primary data gathering mechanism, supplemented by existing data-gathering scripts for news/sentiment. Produce 3-5 picks using the SIMPLEST method first (fundamental + sentiment hybrid), not the most complex.
execution_plan.estimated_session_time: Single session, ~60 minutes of focused work

steps.description: Macro backdrop: Gather current market conditions
actions: Search for current S&P 500 level, VIX, 10-year Treasury yield, Fed funds rate
Search for recent Fed commentary, inflation data, employment situation
Determine current market regime: risk-on, risk-off, transitional
steps.estimated_output: 200-word macro summary establishing context for picks

steps.description: Sector screening: Identify 2-3 sectors with catalysts
actions: Search for sector performance YTD, sector rotation trends
Identify sectors with upcoming catalysts (earnings season, regulatory changes, secular trends)
Filter to sectors with both fundamental and sentiment tailwinds
For each target sector, search for top companies by market cap
Gather key fundamentals: P/E, revenue growth, earnings growth, debt levels
Check recent news sentiment: insider buying, analyst upgrades/downgrades
Identify 8-10 candidates across sectors
Apply fundamental.md checklist to each candidate
Apply sentiment.md checklist (news tone, insider activity, institutional positioning)
Score each candidate on: valuation, growth, moat, sentiment, risk
Rank by composite score
steps.estimated_output: Scored and ranked candidate list with full analysis

actions: For top 3-5 candidates, create pick files using market-research/picks/TEMPLATE.md format
Fill all required fields per SOP-018: ticker, date, entry_price, target_price, stop_loss, method, thesis, risks, confidence
Name files as YYYY-MM-DD_TICKER.md

steps.description: Update index and create KB entry
actions: Update market-research/picks/index.json with all new picks
Create a KB entry documenting the research methodology and results
Validate JSON is well-formed

roles.justification: Manages workflow, ensures SOP-018 compliance, validates pick quality
Gathers financial data, applies fundamental.md checklist, performs valuation analysis. Solo agent for maximum efficiency per SIZE-01.
Gathers news sentiment, insider activity, social signals. Applies sentiment.md checklist. Independent stream from Team A.
Merges findings from both research teams, scores candidates, applies second-method validation per SOP-018 step 5.
Produces pick files from TEMPLATE.md, updates index.json, creates KB entries. Ensures all documentation is complete.

blockers.blocker: No API keys configured for Alpha Vantage or Finnhub
blockers.workaround: Use WebSearch/WebFetch to gather financial data directly from financial websites (Yahoo Finance, MarketWatch, Google Finance). These provide the same data without API keys. API keys only needed for programmatic batch access.
blockers.long_term_fix: Obtain free API keys and store them securely for future sessions

blockers.workaround: WebSearch and WebFetch provide sufficient data gathering for 3-5 picks. Dedicated scripts would only be needed for large-scale quantitative screening (50+ stocks).
blockers.long_term_fix: Build Alpha Vantage and Finnhub wrapper scripts after first picks demonstrate the workflow works

blockers.blocker: Cannot render charts for technical analysis
blockers.workaround: Use fundamental + sentiment methods for first picks (they don't require charts). For technical: use numerical indicator values from Alpha Vantage API or financial websites.
blockers.long_term_fix: Not a real blocker -- professional analysts often work with numerical indicator values

blockers.workaround: The sources/index.json has 41 entries with detail files for all of them. The by_data_type index is comprehensive. Any mismatches between index entries and detail files are cosmetic and do not prevent data access.
blockers.long_term_fix: Run validate-storage.py to identify and fix specific mismatches

blockers.blocker: Rate limiting on free API tiers
blockers.workaround: For 3-5 picks, rate limits are not binding. Alpha Vantage allows 5 calls/min (sufficient for individual stock lookups). Finnhub allows 60 calls/min. WebSearch has no hard limit for manual research.
blockers.long_term_fix: Only relevant when scaling to batch quantitative screening

blockers.workaround: THIS is the real blocker. The solution is discipline, not tooling. SOP-023 exists. The execution plan above requires ZERO new infrastructure. Every tool needed already exists. The team must resist the urge to 'build a better data pipeline first' or 'create a market research framework' and instead JUST DO THE RESEARCH.
blockers.long_term_fix: Enforce SOP-023 pre-launch checklist. Post-session audit for domain artifacts.

critical_insight.the_real_problem: This repository has been stuck in a recursive loop for 14+ team sessions. The infrastructure is DONE. There are 54 scripts, 41 sources, 28+ SOPs, 41 KB entries, and a complete multi-agent coordination system. Yet ZERO domain output exists. The problem is not 'what tools do we need?' -- it is 'will the next team actually use the tools that already exist?'
critical_insight.the_solution: Stop planning. Stop building frameworks. Stop writing SOPs about how to do market research. OPEN market-research/methods/fundamental.md. SEARCH for a company's financials. APPLY the checklist. WRITE the pick file. UPDATE the index. That is the entire workflow. It takes one agent 30 minutes.
critical_insight.minimum_viable_output: One single pick file (market-research/picks/2026-03-11_AAPL.md) with all required fields filled in would represent more domain output than the last 14 teams combined.
critical_insight.sop_023_compliance: This strategy document itself is the LAST piece of analysis needed. The next action must be execution, not more analysis.

immediate_next_actions: 1. STOP reading this document and START researching stocks
2. Use WebSearch to find current S&P 500 top/bottom performers this quarter
3. Pick the most interesting sector based on macro conditions
4. Research 3 companies in that sector using WebSearch/WebFetch
5. Apply fundamental.md checklist to score them
6. Write pick files using TEMPLATE.md for the top 3
8. Create ONE KB entry documenting the methodology and results
